Initial release of AI Maker Generator for fast AI-powered video creation.

- Instantly generates 30-second promotional videos from your images and clips with background music — no editing skills required.
- Supports uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG) and delivers 1080p MP4 exports in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatically manages cloud session setup and API tokens, with 100 free credits on first use.
- Includes guided flows for uploading, generating, previewing, exporting, and checking credits.
- Robust error handling for unsupported files, session issues, missing headers, and export/account problems.
